small_guidance: Keep the GEMM autotune space but fix correctness: GPT-2's MLP uses an exact GELU (erf-based) by default, not tanh approximation. Either (a) switch the fused ACT=1 path to compute 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/sqrt(2))) using tl.erf, or (b) check config.activation_function and only fuse tanh-GELU when it's 'gelu_new'/'gelu_pytorch_tanh'; otherwise leave mlp.act untouched and pass act=0. Also verify NaNs aren't from uninitialized bias_ptr aliasing — pass a real zero tensor when HAS_BIAS=False.
large_guidance: Redesign so the Triton replacement is a drop-in for HF Conv1D that exactly matches its numerics: (1) implement matmul + bias only, leave activation as the original nn.GELU/NewGELU module so activation correctness is never a concern; (2) if fusion is desired, dispatch on config.activation_function and implement both exact-erf GELU and tanh-approx GELU variants, selected per-block via a constexpr; (3) consider fusing the residual add and LayerNorm input prep at the c_proj output to reduce memory traffic, since pure GEMM replacement on a 4090 will be close to cuBLAS.
